# external — what Cora receives, never what she hoards

Incoming designs, suggestions and papers from guests (Qwen et al.), at the chair's hand.
Law 2 applies the moment a file lands: hash it, register it here (`{path, sha256, bytes, source,
obtained, by, script, notes}`), and it becomes citable. Unregistered arrivals are *lodgers, not
residents* — Cora's tools may not consume them until the manifest says so.

Standing arrangement for UI prototypes: a design may become Cora's **skin** (the markup and style
of `docs/index.html`); it may not become her **voice** — every number on any page stays generated
from the ledgers by `bin/homepage.sh` (AGENTS §8-addendum-3: *a shadow may not move independently
of the body*).
